name: java
description: Java language guidance (Java 21+, examples for 25): idioms, records, sealed types, exceptions, concurrency, performance, and a review checklist for the judge.
decides: The stack ADR chooses Java as an implementation language.

build-tool.description: The build tool the ADR chose; sets HARNESS_BUILD_CMD, HARNESS_TEST_CMD and HARNESS_TEST_PATHS.

options.description: Tests use JUnit 5 with AssertJ assertions only: installs the java-test skill, blocks JUnit 4 and JUnit assertion imports.
Lombok is not used: records, static factories and explicit constructors instead; Lombok imports are blocked.
